en.headline: Government gazettes bill to establish Centre for Medical Products Regulation
en.dek: The Centre for Medical Products Regulation Bill was gazetted on Friday to give the new body statutory status and unify oversight of Chinese and Western medicines and future medical devices.
body: The Centre for Medical Products Regulation Bill was gazetted on Friday to establish the statutory status of the Centre for Medical Products Regulation and rationalise the regulatory framework for Chinese and Western medicines as well as medical devices.

The Secretary for Health, Professor Lo Chung-mau, said the establishment of the centre marked a significant milestone in Hong Kong’s regulatory reform of medical products. He said the government would align with the national 15th Five-Year Plan and leverage the city’s advantages under one country, two systems to build a more proactive evaluation and approval mechanism so that advanced products could reach patients faster.

Major proposals include establishing the centre as a body corporate that can represent Hong Kong, China in international regulatory affairs and form long-term relationships with leading authorities; transferring existing regulatory powers for Chinese and Western medicines from the Pharmacy and Poisons Board and the Chinese Medicines Board to the Director of Health; and making supporting technical amendments. The bill will be introduced into the Legislative Council for first reading on 25 November.

zh.headline: 政府刊憲《藥械監管中心條例草案》確立法定地位
zh.dek: 《藥物及醫療器械監督管理中心條例草案》周五刊憲，確立藥械監管中心法定地位，並理順中西藥及未來醫療器械的規管架構。
body: 《藥物及醫療器械監督管理中心條例草案》今日刊憲，旨在確立藥物及醫療器械監督管理中心的法定地位，並理順中、西藥及未來醫療器械的規管架構。
醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，成立藥械監管中心是香港藥械監管制度改革的重要里程碑。政府會全面主動對接國家十五五規劃，發揮香港在一國兩制下的獨特優勢，建立更主動的審評審批機制，讓先進藥械更快引入香港，惠及病人，並推動香港成為國際醫療創新樞紐。
草案主要建議包括成立中心為法人團體，代表中國香港參與國際監管事務，並與高水平機構建立正式長遠工作關係；將現時分散於藥劑業及毒藥管理局、中醫藥管理委員會中藥組的相關權力轉移至衞生署署長，統一規管架構；以及完善配套及技術修訂。草案將於十一月二十五日提交立法會首讀。
